seo.title: Pricing
seo.description: Discord Analytics is free, with no paid tier and no feature gate. Here are the limits that actually apply, and the public ledger showing how the project is funded.

badge: Free, and the books are public
title: There is no price list
description: Every feature is available to every account. What follows is the honest version: the limits that do apply, and exactly who pays for the servers.

included.title: All of it, on every account
included.description: There is no free plan and no pro plan, so there is nothing to compare. Everything below is on by default.
included.note: Pick any feature to see what it does.

limits.title: The limits that do apply
limits.description: Not a paywall — just the ceilings that keep one account from consuming the whole server. You can see your own usage against them in your account settings.

raise.1: Need more than this? Limits are raised on request —
raise.3: and tell us what you're building.

funding.title: Brought to you by
funding.description: No company and no ad budget behind this — just the people who write the code, and the people who cover the bill for running it. Both lists below are live.

contribute.title: Contribute on Open Collective
contribute.description: One-off or monthly. This is what keeps the servers paid for.

ledger.title: Read the ledger
ledger.description: Every transaction in and out, public.

self_hosting.title: Or don't depend on us at all
self_hosting.description: Run the whole stack yourself with Docker, on your own hardware, with your own database.

faq.title: The questions this page should answer

1.question: Is it really free, or is this a trial?
1.answer: It's free. There is no trial period, no credit card and no paid tier to upgrade to — the same features are on every account, and the limits above are the only ceilings.

2.question: What happens if the donations stop?

answer.1: That's the fair question to ask any donation-funded service, and the ledger is public so you can watch for it. The project is open source, so if the hosted version ever stopped, you could
answer.3: with your existing data — nothing here is locked to our servers.

3.question: Do you sell my data or my users' data?

answer.1: No. The project is funded by donations, not by data. What we collect and how long we keep it is written down in the
answer.3: , and the code that does it is public.

4.question: I've hit a limit. Now what?
4.answer: Ask. Limits are per account and per bot, and they are raised on request — there's no plan to buy, just tell our team what you need and why.
